title: CodesRemind
description: This plugin adds a code system with /code and money rewards for typing it.
body:
/code add <name> <standard|special> <amount>
for admins with permssion code.create for creating a new code.

/code <name> for player witg permission code.code for redeeming a code

The Money-Reward-Amount can be configured in the config.

Types:
Standart: A player can only redeem a standard code once in their lifetime. (Ideal for creator codes)

Special: A player can redeem each existing special code once in their lifetime. However, this has no effect on standard codes and other special codes. (Ideal for event codes or sponsors)

Amount: The amount of money credited to the player

Requirements: The server has an economy system such as xConomy or EssentialsX.
